errors.name: InvalidHaltMode
errors.msg: Invalid halt mode — must be 0 (None), 1 (ReduceOnly), or 2 (Full)

errors.name: TradingKeyExpiryTooLong
errors.msg: Trading key expiry exceeds the maximum allowed TTL

errors.name: QueueDrawWhileDelegated
errors.msg: A delegate may not draw queue collateral (wallet-only when delegated)

errors.name: InvalidOptimalUsage
errors.msg: Invalid optimal usage factor — must be < PRECISION

errors.name: MustBePaused
errors.msg: Market must be paused for migration

errors.name: MissingFeeDistributorAccounts
errors.msg: Missing fee-distributor remaining accounts (need 4: program, fee_pool, referral_reserve, token_program)

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Invalid market config — inconsistent or default-pubkey field

errors.name: QueueCollateralExceedsClaim
errors.msg: Position's collateral_from_queue exceeds available user claim

errors.name: WalletAndQueueZero
errors.msg: Both wallet_collateral and from_queue_amount are zero

errors.name: MissingQueueEntryAccount
errors.msg: Liquidation flow: required queue entry account missing

errors.name: LeverageExceedsTierCap
errors.msg: Requested leverage exceeds the current-session tier cap for this wallet's notional

errors.name: MalformedQueueEntry
errors.msg: Liquidation clawback: queue entry/claims account malformed or too short

errors.name: QueueOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: Liquidation clawback: queue entry/claims owner != liquidated position owner

errors.name: QueueMarketMismatch
errors.msg: Liquidation clawback: queue entry/claims belongs to a different market

errors.name: InitialMarginUnmet
errors.msg: Initial margin requirement not met (collateral below notional * initial_margin_bps)

errors.name: InsufficientFreeLiquidity
errors.msg: Pool free liquidity is below the open-side floor; new opens are gated until the queue drains or LPs deposit

errors.name: CannotRemoveQueueCollateral
errors.msg: Cannot remove queue-sourced collateral; it can only exit via close

errors.name: ClawbackEntriesInsufficient
errors.msg: Liquidation clawback: too few queue entries passed to void the released lien (min(clawback, unpaid_owed) not covered)

errors.name: FundingCadenceTooFast
errors.msg: update_funding_rate called within 5s of last update

errors.name: WrongMarketRisk
errors.msg: Category shape: MarketRisk account fails the seed-derived binding (forged/wrong market)

errors.name: WrongCategory
errors.msg: Category shape: MarketRisk.category_id does not match the CategoryPool

errors.name: CategoryReserveFactorExceeded
errors.msg: Category shape: per-market reserve_factor rail exceeded (reserved share of category free_liquidity)

errors.name: PositionHasWalletCollateral
errors.msg: void_position: position carries real wallet collateral — refusing to void (use the normal close path)

errors.name: CreditOnlyOpenForbidden
errors.msg: Real (wallet) collateral must independently meet the minimum; credit cannot open a position alone

errors.name: CreditExceedsMatchCap
errors.msg: Applied credit exceeds the 1:1 match cap (credit must be <= real collateral)
